How To Make Your Restaurant Viral? Social Media Marketing Strategy For Restaurants:

Social media plays a vital role if you are running a business in a digitally focused world. The first and foremost advantage of social media marketing is it helps your business reach out to prospective customers who can be your customers. Posting photos about your food products alone will not be enough to help you get the results you are expecting.

Most of your competitors must be focusing on social media marketing strategy for restaurants, and you can even go for it as it can help you get more sales for your business. In this blog, we will help guide you through some of the social media marketing tips that can help you promote your food business in 2022. 

If you still believe that social media cannot drive results for your business, here are some facts that will surprise you. 

  • 60% of restaurants are using social media marketing.
  • 51% of consumers learn about new restaurants or food companies through social media vloggers. 
  • 37% of internet users use social media to research restaurants over the internet. 

What are the latest trends in Social Media Marketing For Food businesses?

When the concern is about social media, the focus is completely on branding and showcasing your business as an industry leader can help you authenticate your brand and connect your target consumers with your brand. 

For example, if you are promoting a milk-based beverage or instant mixes like Bournvita or Horlicks, you have to focus on a mother’s point of view who is worried about their child’s appetite. Using such strategies has driven positive results for various brands and can drive for yours too. 

So, now that you know that social media marketing is quite essential for your business let us get into the essential section where you will learn how you can use social media to promote your food business. 

So, let’s get started!

How To Promote Your Restaurant or Food Via Social Media?

1: Selecting the Right Social Media Platform:

Well, there are so many social media platforms on the internet, and finding the right one to promote your business is not easy. 

According to recent research Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram are three of the ideal social media platforms for promoting the food business. 

59% of people prefer to stream content related to food or vloggers on Facebook, which makes it the best platform to promote your restaurant or food. So, when setting up your brand’s profile on any of the social media platforms, you must focus on completing and optimizing your profile completely. 

You must ensure that every time a user lands on your page, they must get complete information about your business location, timings, reservations, and contact details. 

2: Craft your content professionally:

There is no doubt that simply creating social media profiles for your business is not enough, as you have to also focus on posting quality content that will help you in getting the reach for your business. 

You must have a monthly content calendar for your restaurant or food to ensure that you don’t miss out on any of the important occasions. For example, you can check out the tweet of one of our clients, “Kiscol Grands”, which is one of the leading hotels in Coimbatore.

3: Optimizing Your Digital Presence:

Sometimes, social media marketing alone is not enough to help you get desired results for your business. You must also focus on other aspects of digital marketing. The message is clear: people must find your restaurant or food product everywhere on the internet. 

When you are posting content on social media, you have to focus on not linking your homepage but to different pages from where they can place orders or get a particular detail about a product or service. 

We at Eon8 can help you create a Google my business page listing for your business, which can help you win over your local competitors and will also help you in attracting local customers to your business. 

4: Focus on posting quality Images and Videos:

Marketing a restaurant or food on social media is to make people crave the dish, or at least they must feel that they should try the food at least one time. Not having quality images or videos to describe your dishes will lead to poor engagement, slowly affecting your business. So, post quality pictures and videos about your restaurant or food products. 

https://bit.ly/3FyftTv

5: Significance of posting at the right time:

When the concern is about Social Media Marketing, “Timing is crucial” you have to post at the right time to make the most of your social media followers. When we talk about timing, we are not saying that you have to post at the exact time. For example, you cannot post about breakfast in the early morning, so you have to post at bedtime so they can connect with your business.
